property_summary: For any play() with exactly TICKET_AMOUNT wei, the reference C's pot either stays 0 or grows/zeroes consistently without an arithmetic underflow, while M's pot -= msg.value underflows and reverts when pot < msg.value, so we assert pot before any winning branch remains at least the ticket amount (reference) rather than reverting.
change_summary: Change pot accumulation from += msg.value to -= msg.value, causing an underflow revert when pot is less than msg.value.
